mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing supply shocks (INDPRO growth below 0.5% annually) increase input costs and reduce corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth is below 0.5% annually.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY change above 2.5%) signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained employment growth above 150k monthly (PAYEMS) supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150k.

mechanism_narrative: Residential construction below 550k units (HOUST) signals housing market weakness, reducing consumer wealth and spending, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls below 550.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP (GDPC1) indicate systemic supply chain disruptions, increasing costs and reducing corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline.
